flaws.description: Workers select queued jobs and then update them in separate statements, so two overlapping cron invocations claim and process the same job twice; needs FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED or an atomic claim
The cron route has no CRON_SECRET or authorization check, so anyone who finds the URL can trigger expensive processing runs
The plan assumes a 15-minute execution limit for Vercel cron functions, but the default serverless maxDuration is far lower, so 50 images per invocation will be cut off mid-batch
keywords: timeout|maxduration|max duration|duration limit|time limit|execution limit|15-minute|15 minute|cut off

flaws.description: The original upload is deleted immediately and the temp copy expires after one hour, so any job that fails or waits longer than an hour loses the photo permanently
Transient failures such as storage timeouts mark the job failed forever with no retry, backoff or dead-letter handling, even though attempts and run_at exist
The per-minute polling query filters image_jobs on status and run_at with no index, and the 180k-row backfill makes it a full scan every minute
